from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetrics(BaseModel):
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    faculty_count: int | None = Field(description="Total number of full-time instructional faculty")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Total number of first-year applicants")
    admitted: int | None = Field(description="Total number of admitted first-year applicants")
    enrolled: int | None = Field(description="Total number of enrolled first-year students")
    graduation_rate_2015: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for the Fall 2015 cohort as a percentage")
    reporting_year: str | None = Field(description="Academic or reporting year of the data (e.g., '2021-2022')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetrics]
